name: Life Essence
description: A glowing orb of pure life energy. Prized by alchemists for crafting.

name: Poison Vial
description: A small vial of concentrated poison harvested from slain creatures.

name: Life Berry
description: A magical berry that pulses with natural life energy. Rare and valuable.

name: Mana Berry
description: A vibrant blue berry infused with arcane essence. Used in many magical concoctions.

name: Fermented Sugar
description: A sticky, golden substance with a pungent sweet aroma. A volatile alchemical base.

name: Starlight Nectar
description: A luminous, glowing silver-blue liquid that pulses with magical aura. Extremely rare.

name: Bronze Key
description: A heavy, tarnished bronze key. Looks like it fits a large lock.

name: Bone Key
description: A heavy, bone key. Looks like it fits a large lock.

name: Gold Coins
description: A pile of glittering gold coins.

name: Ogre's Head
description: The severed head of a mighty ogre. A gruesome but valuable alchemical trophy.

name: Minotaur Horn
description: A massive, curved horn from a minotaur. Infused with raw physical power.

name: Aqua Man Flipper
description: A scaly flipper from an aquatic humanoid. Useful for potions of water breathing or agility.

name: Demon's Eyes
description: A pair of glowing eyes from a low-level demon. They still seem to track movement.

name: Iron Ore
description: A heavy chunk of raw iron ore. Can be smelted and forged into powerful gear.

name: Lizard Scale
description: A tough, shimmering scale from a lizard warrior. Excellent for reinforcing leather armor.

name: Crocodile Hide
description: A thick, durable piece of crocodile hide covering. Its tough ridges are perfect for crafting heavy-duty leather armor.

name: Giant's Loin Cloth
description: A massive, tattered piece of crude cloth and fur from a giant's attire. Smells of ozone and mountain air.

name: Giant's Club
description: A crudely fashioned tree trunk, too heavy for mortals but a formidable weapon in a giant's hands.

name: Ancient Heartwood
description: A dense, pulsing core of living wood carved from deep within the Treeman. Ancient beyond reckoning, it hums with primordial forest energy.

name: Blue Crystal
description: A powerful blue crystal pulsing with mystical energy. It looks like it might be part of a larger mechanism.

name: Red Crystal
description: A powerful red crystal glowing with intense fiery energy. It feels warm to the touch.

name: Broken Sun-Forged Key
description: A shattered key of solar gold. Though broken, its fragments still thrum with the heat of a dying star.

name: Sun-Forged Key
description: A majestic key forged in the heart of a celestial forge. It radiates a blinding solar brilliance.

name: Aether-Glass Silt
description: Finely ground crystalline particles that shimmer with iridescent Aether energy. Used in the most advanced crafting.

name: Aqua Man Essence
description: A shimmering blue-green orb containing the core essence of an Aqua Man.

name: Crocodile Warrior Essence
description: A tough, swampy orb containing the core essence of a Crocodile Warrior.

name: Demon Ogre Essence
description: A chaotic, fiery orb containing the core essence of a Demon Ogre.

name: Demon Essence
description: A malicious, glowing orb containing the core essence of a Demon.

name: Giant Essence
description: A massive, earthy orb containing the core essence of a Giant.

name: Lizard Man Essence
description: A reptilian, vibrant orb containing the core essence of a Lizard Man.

name: Minotaur Essence
description: A powerful, blood-orange orb containing the core essence of a Minotaur.

name: Ogre Essence
description: A brutish, mossy orb containing the core essence of an Ogre.

name: Tree Man Essence
description: A nature-infused, wood-like orb containing the core essence of a Tree Man.
